summary: All 5 acceptance criteria verified. STAGES registry has exactly 8 entries with no wp_scoped field. _render_stage passes only {**_BASE_VARS, **extra_vars} with no wp_id. render_and_write always writes a single {stage}.md file. --list and --stage CLI flags work correctly per arg parser logic. Script uses pathlib throughout (cross-platform) with explicit UTF-8 encoding. No security concerns. Code is clean and well-documented.

comments.note: MappingProxyType for _BASE_VARS is a good defensive pattern — prevents accidental mutation of the shared base variables dict across render calls. Correct use of an immutable container.

load_template() is called inside _render_stage() on each invocation (per-stage disk read) rather than at module level. For a dev-tooling script run once per invocation this is perfectly acceptable — no performance concern. Intentional given STAGES is a registry list rather than individual pre-cached handles.
